follow_ups.note: Review the working-tree diff in the PBI-001 worktree for GO / NO-GO.
When a whole session cannot be parsed, export_sessions keeps its last result as-is, so a running row there is not reclassified; only the agent-level carry (the AC-57 case) is covered.

Per the brief, any marker with at most 3 leading spaces is a new idea, so a conventional 2-space nested bullet under '- a' becomes its own idea; nested items (4+ spaces) are dropped from the export until the page can render them as a list.
exercised / fallback-declared use verdict_of's tiers (labelled, then bold/code, then bare). A bare 'not exercised' in a result with no labelled word would read as exercised.
runs.manual ids are checked only as strings but become file names under out/runs/; consider the local app's run-id form.
Close A-45 and mark FR-80, FR-81, FR-82, FR-84 and FR-133 as met in docs/prd/dispatch-board.md, and tick the PBI-001 ACs; docs/** is outside this change's areas.
